entries.4bd57eb1f2844398: A business operating restaurant formats other than curry, including the anakake spaghetti specialty restaurant “Pasta de Coco”, “Asahikawa Jingisukan Daikokuya”, “Menya Takei”, “Hakata Motsunabe Maedaya”, “Ramen Kozo”, and the late-night parfait specialty restaurant “Parfeteria Pal”. It expands its formats through acquiring shares in companies that operate thriving restaurants popular in their local areas. Sales in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥5,487 million.
entries.5727969f9c32ddc2: The group is a single segment consisting of the restaurant business and related ancillary operations.
entries.8a2b63728b793f19: A company that operates the curry specialty restaurant "Curry House CoCo Ichibanya" in Japan and overseas through directly managed stores and franchises, and also operates restaurants of new formats.
entries.bd2947d5ff104fc0: A business operating Curry House CoCo Ichibanya domestically and overseas through company-operated stores and franchised stores (FC stores). For FC stores, it provides store management guidance and sells ingredients, consumables and store equipment and other merchandise used in the stores, and it also lends its trademarks to food manufacturers and others. Sales in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥60,031 million. As of February 28, 2026, the number of CoCo Ichibanya stores in Japan was 1,205 (118 company-operated stores and 1,087 FC stores).
entries.dc917b634ab64a2a: The group is a single segment consisting of the restaurant business and related ancillary operations. It consists of the Curry Business, centered on the curry specialty restaurant chain Curry House CoCo Ichibanya, and the New Format Business, which operates restaurant formats other than curry. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, sales by business division were ¥60,031 million for the Curry Business and ¥5,487 million for the New Format Business.
